verdict.rationale: cubic documents a dedicated cross-repo review feature: you link related repositories so reviews can catch changes that need a matching update elsewhere, such as shared APIs, schemas, docs or release work. Its review chat also reads the rest of the codebase beyond the PR diff, and an AI wiki indexes the codebase, which supports coherent cross-cutting understanding. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of large-monorepo scale handling, detail on how cross-repo findings are presented in a single coherent review, and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-repo review quality.
